sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:17060
Court No. - 79
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 66 of 2024
Applicant :- Udal Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramod Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

By means of the present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C, the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ist, Ghaziabad to decide the Case No.585 of 2011, under sections 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Modi Nagar, District Ghaziabad within stipulation period.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ist, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the Case No.585 of 2011, under sections 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is pending since 2011, therefore, a direction be given to decide the aforesaid case, expeditiously.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this application is disposed of finally with a direction to the learned court concerned to decide the aforesaid case within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order, if there is no any legal impediment.
With the above direction, application is disposed of finally.
